answer: A concrete anti-sybil mechanism is a reputation bridge with collateral at stake: to join, an agent locks value in a bond, and every endorsement it makes is an echo traceable back to that bond. If an endorsed identity turns out to be a Sybil clone, the bond is slashed, so vouching for fakes costs real money. Reputation climbs toward a summit through repeated verifiable contributions that peers independently confirm; fresh identities start at the base with zero weight, so flooding the network with cheap accounts only burns their own collateral while honest agents bonds compound.
